# Code of Conduct

This project welcomes practical, respectful collaboration.

Contributors must:

- discuss ideas and code without personal attacks;
- respect privacy and obtain consent before sharing face images or personal data;
- give actionable technical feedback;
- avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, and publication of private information.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions and participation that violate these
rules. Report conduct concerns through the repository's private maintainer
contact channel or a GitHub security advisory when confidentiality is required.
